def.short: money that you get from work or other things, usually each month or year
def.long: All the money a person, a family or a company gets regularly, for example from a job, rent or investments. People often talk about a high or a low one.

grammar.pattern: a high/low income; income from sth

examples.en: Rent takes half of my income.
examples.tr: Kira gelirimin yarısını götürüyor.

examples.en: Families on a low income will pay less tax next year.
examples.tr: Düşük gelirli aileler gelecek yıl daha az vergi ödeyecek.

examples.en: Emre has a second income from renting out his apartment.
examples.tr: Emre dairesini kiraya vererek ikinci bir gelir elde ediyor.

tr.note: 'Income' bütün gelirdir: maaş, kira, faiz. Yalnızca işten her ay alınan para 'salary' olur. Gelir vergisi 'income tax' denir.

quiz.cloze: After she lost her job, the family had to live on one ______.

def.short: money that you spend on something, especially regular costs like rent or travel
def.long: Money that you have to spend on something. In the plural it often means all the money you spend on a trip or for work, which a company may give back to you.

examples.en: A car is a big expense.
examples.tr: Araba büyük bir masraftır.

examples.en: The company pays all my travel expenses.
examples.tr: Şirket tüm yol masraflarımı karşılıyor.

examples.en: We wrote down every expense for a month to see where our money went.
examples.tr: Paramızın nereye gittiğini görmek için bir ay boyunca her harcamayı not ettik.

tr.note: Çoğu zaman çoğul kullanılır: 'travel expenses' (yol masrafları), 'living expenses' (geçim masrafları). Sıfatı 'expensive' (pahalı).

quiz.cloze: My boss said the company will pay for my travel ______.

def.short: money that you have kept and not spent, often in a bank
def.long: Money that you have put away over time, often in a bank account, so that you can use it later or in an emergency. In this meaning it is always plural.

examples.en: We spent all our savings on the house.
examples.tr: Bütün birikimimizi eve harcadık.

examples.en: Kerem opened a savings account for his daughter.
examples.tr: Kerem kızı için bir tasarruf hesabı açtı.

examples.en: With prices rising so fast, many people are living on their savings.
examples.tr: Fiyatlar bu kadar hızlı artarken pek çok insan birikimleriyle geçiniyor.

tr.note: Para anlamında hep çoğuldur: 'my savings'. Tekil 'saving' daha çok bir şeyden yapılan tasarruftur: 'a saving of 50 lira'.

mistakes.wrong: I spent all my saving on a new car.
mistakes.right: I spent all my savings on a new car.
mistakes.why: Türkçede 'birikimim' tekil olduğu için sondaki 's' unutuluyor. Para anlamında 'savings' hep çoğuldur.

quiz.cloze: She used her ______ to pay for her master's degree.

entries.sense_note: extra money paid on a loan or savings

def.micro: extra money paid on a loan
def.short: the extra money you pay when you borrow, or get when you keep money in a bank
def.long: Extra money that you pay to a bank when you borrow money, or that a bank pays you for keeping your money there. It is shown as a percentage called the rate.

grammar.pattern: pay/charge interest on sth; interest rate

examples.en: The bank charges high interest on loans.
examples.tr: Banka kredilere yüksek faiz uyguluyor.

examples.en: The central bank raised interest rates again.
examples.tr: Merkez bankası faiz oranlarını yine artırdı.

examples.en: If you pay late, you will have to pay interest on the full amount.
examples.tr: Geç öderseniz tüm tutar üzerinden faiz ödemek zorunda kalırsınız.

tr.note: Bu anlamda sayılamaz: 'pay interest'. Faiz oranı 'interest rate' olur. Aynı kelime 'ilgi' anlamına da gelir: 'an interest in music'.

quiz.cloze: If you borrow 10,000 lira, you will pay back the money plus ______.

entries.sense_note: money put into something to make profit

def.micro: money put in to make profit
def.short: money that you put into a business, property or shares to make more money later
def.long: Money that you put into something, such as a business, a house or shares, because you hope it will bring you more money later. It can also mean the thing you put money into.

grammar.pattern: an investment in sth; make an investment

examples.en: Buying an apartment is a good investment.
examples.tr: Daire almak iyi bir yatırımdır.

examples.en: The government wants more foreign investment in the energy sector.
examples.tr: Hükümet enerji sektörüne daha fazla yabancı yatırım istiyor.

examples.en: Learning English was the best investment I ever made.
examples.tr: İngilizce öğrenmek yaptığım en iyi yatırımdı.

tr.note: 'Yatırım yapmak' 'make an investment' olur. Fiil olarak 'invest in sth' de denir: 'invest in gold'.

mistakes.wrong: We did a big investment in our shop.
mistakes.right: We made a big investment in our shop.
mistakes.why: 'Yatırım yapmak' kelime kelime çevrilince 'do' seçiliyor. İngilizcede 'make an investment' denir.

quiz.cloze: Solar panels are expensive, but they are a smart long-term ______.

def.short: the money that a business makes after it pays all its costs
def.long: The money that you make when you sell something for more than it cost you, or what a company has left after paying all its costs. The opposite is a loss.

grammar.pattern: make a profit; at a profit

examples.en: The café made a small profit last year.
examples.tr: Kafe geçen yıl biraz kâr etti.

examples.en: The company's profits rose by 20 percent.
examples.tr: Şirketin kârı yüzde 20 arttı.

examples.en: Ali bought the car for 300,000 lira and sold it at a profit.
examples.tr: Ali arabayı 300.000 liraya alıp kârla sattı.

tr.note: 'Kâr etmek' 'make a profit' olur. Zıt anlamlısı 'loss' (zarar): 'make a loss'. 'Prophet' (peygamber) ile aynı okunur.

quiz.cloze: The bakery sold its cakes for more than they cost to make, so it made a ______.

entries.sense_note: paying a company to cover future loss

def.short: an agreement where you pay a company and it pays you after a loss or accident
def.long: An agreement in which you pay a company a regular amount of money, and the company pays you if you have an accident, get ill, or something you own is lost or damaged.

grammar.pattern: insurance for/on sth; get/take out insurance

examples.en: Do you have travel insurance?
examples.tr: Seyahat sigortanız var mı?

examples.en: My car insurance went up by 40 percent this year.
examples.tr: Araba sigortam bu yıl yüzde 40 zamlandı.

examples.en: The insurance company paid for the damage after the flood.
examples.tr: Selden sonra hasarı sigorta şirketi karşıladı.

tr.note: 'Sigorta yaptırmak' 'get insurance' ya da 'take out insurance' olur. Fiili 'insure', 'ensure' (sağlamak) ile sık karıştırılır.

mistakes.wrong: I made insurance for my car.
mistakes.right: I got insurance for my car.
mistakes.why: 'Sigorta yaptırmak' kelime kelime 'make insurance' diye çevriliyor. İngilizcede 'get' ya da 'take out insurance' denir.

quiz.cloze: Our ______ will pay for the new window that the storm broke.

def.short: an amount of money that you give for something, or the act of giving it
def.long: An amount of money that you give to someone for something you bought or for a service, or the act of giving this money. It can be in cash, by card or online.

grammar.pattern: make a payment; payment for sth

examples.en: We only accept card payments.
examples.tr: Yalnızca kartla ödeme kabul ediyoruz.

examples.en: I made the last payment on my phone yesterday.
examples.tr: Telefonumun son ödemesini dün yaptım.

examples.en: Payment must be made within 30 days of the invoice date.
examples.tr: Ödemenin fatura tarihinden itibaren 30 gün içinde yapılması gerekir.

tr.note: 'Ödeme yapmak' 'make a payment' olur. Peşinat 'down payment', aylık ödeme 'monthly payment' denir.

mistakes.why: 'Ödeme yapmak' kelime kelime çevrilince 'do' seçiliyor. İngilizcede 'make a payment' denir.

quiz.cloze: The shop accepts ______ by card, cash or phone.

def.short: one of several equal amounts you pay over time until the full price is paid
def.long: One of a number of regular amounts of money that you pay over a period of time until you have paid for something completely. In British English it is spelled 'instalment'.

examples.en: I'm paying for my laptop in installments.
examples.tr: Dizüstü bilgisayarımı taksitle ödüyorum.

examples.en: The phone costs 30,000 lira, or 12 monthly installments of 2,700.
examples.tr: Telefon 30.000 lira ya da aylık 2.700 liradan 12 taksit.

examples.en: Deniz missed two installments, so the bank called her.
examples.tr: Deniz iki taksidi ödemeyince banka onu aradı.

tr.note: 'Taksitle almak' 'buy in installments' ya da 'pay in installments' olur. İngiliz yazımı 'instalment'.

mistakes.wrong: I bought this sofa with installments.
mistakes.right: I bought this sofa in installments.
mistakes.why: Türkçedeki '-le' eki ('taksitle') 'with' diye çevriliyor. İngilizcede 'in installments' denir.

quiz.cloze: You can pay for the course in six monthly ______.

def.short: money that you pay to a bank, school, doctor or lawyer for a service
def.long: An amount of money that you pay for a professional service or for the right to do something, for example to join a club, enter a museum or keep a bank account.

grammar.pattern: a fee for sth; charge a fee

examples.en: The bank charges a monthly fee.
examples.tr: Banka aylık bir ücret alıyor.

examples.en: University fees have gone up again this year.
examples.tr: Üniversite harçları bu yıl yine arttı.

examples.en: There is a small fee for using another bank's ATM.
examples.tr: Başka bir bankanın ATM'sini kullanmanın küçük bir ücreti var.

tr.note: Türkçedeki 'ücret' İngilizcede birkaç kelimeye ayrılır: hizmet için 'fee', yolculuk için 'fare', iş karşılığı 'wage', ürün için 'price'.

mistakes.wrong: How much is the bus fee?
mistakes.right: How much is the bus fare?
mistakes.why: Türkçede hepsine 'ücret' denir. Otobüs, taksi ya da uçak yolculuğu için İngilizcede 'fare' kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: To join the gym, you have to pay a membership ______ of 500 lira.

entries.sense_note: first part paid to reserve something

def.micro: first part of a price paid
def.short: part of the price that you pay first so that something is kept for you
def.long: Part of the full price that you pay at the start, so that the seller keeps the thing for you. It is also money you give a landlord and get back if nothing is damaged.

examples.en: We paid a deposit on the wedding hall.
examples.tr: Düğün salonu için kapora verdik.

examples.en: To book the room, you need to pay a 20 percent deposit.
examples.tr: Odayı ayırtmak için yüzde 20 ön ödeme yapmanız gerekiyor.

examples.en: When we moved out, the landlord gave us our deposit back.
examples.tr: Evden çıkınca ev sahibi depozitomuzu geri verdi.

tr.note: Rezervasyon ya da satın almada 'kapora, ön ödeme'; kiralık evde 'depozito' anlamına gelir. Bankaya para yatırmak da 'deposit' olur.

quiz.cloze: The hotel asked us to pay a ______ of 1,000 lira to hold the room until Friday.

entries.sense_note: person who buys goods or services

def.short: a person who buys and uses products and services
def.long: Any person who buys products or services for their own use. The word is common in economics, news and law, for example 'consumer rights' and 'consumer prices'.

examples.en: Consumers are spending less on clothes.
examples.tr: Tüketiciler kıyafete daha az para harcıyor.

examples.en: If the shop won't help, you can go to a consumer rights office.
examples.tr: Mağaza yardımcı olmazsa tüketici hakları bürosuna gidebilirsiniz.

examples.en: Consumer prices rose by 3 percent last month.
examples.tr: Tüketici fiyatları geçen ay yüzde 3 arttı.

tr.note: Mağazadaki alıcıya 'customer' (müşteri) denir. 'Consumer' daha geneldir: ekonomide, haberlerde ve yasalarda ürünü alıp kullanan herkes.

quiz.cloze: New laws protect ______ from unfair prices and faulty products.
